dishes.title: Masala Chicken Pulao
dishes.subtitle: From Ralston D'Souza
steps: To a pan on medium heat add:
2 tbsp Ghee (original recipe also used oil, but just go with ghee)
1 large sliced Onion (100g)
Cook till translucent (2 to 3 min)
Mix and cook till the tomatoes nicely soften.
Juice of half a Lime (10ml)
When it boils consistently, add a handful of Coriander, cover and bring the flame to low.
25 min later, remove the lid and it’s ready to serve.
Calories per serve - 633 kcal

dishes.title: Village Style Desi Chicken Curry
dishes.subtitle: From Ralston D'Souza
steps: Heat mustard oil in a pot over medium heat
Add cumin seeds, black cardamom, cinnamon stick, green cardamoms and cloves
Add onions, mix well and cook until golden brown
Add garlic, ginger and tomatoes, mix everything well and cook until the tomatoes soften
Add red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, green chillies and coriander leaves
Add chicken and salt, mix well and cook for 10 minutes
Pour in water and mix well
Cover and cook for 30 minutes, keeping the heat on medium throughout

dishes.title: Hot Honey Garlic Chicken Bread 🥖 🍯
dishes.subtitle: From Iram Mansoor
steps: Hot Honey Garlic Chicken Bread 🥖 🍯
Ingredients
For the Chicken
1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into small bite-size pieces
Salt to taste
For the Hot Honey
Pinch of salt
For the Garlic Butter
For the Garlic Bread
Fresh parsley, for garnish
For the Hot Honey Garlic Aioli
Pinch of salt
Instructions
Add honey, hot sauce, red pepper flakes, smoked paprika, butter, lemon juice, and salt to a small saucepan. Heat over low heat for 1–2 minutes, stirring until combined and glossy. Set aside.
Add chicken, oil, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, chili powder, black pepper, salt, and cornstarch to a bowl. Toss to coat.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add a little oil and cook chicken for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
Mix softened butter, garlic, parsley, garlic powder, salt, and Parmesan until combined.

Mix mayonnaise, hot honey, garlic, lemon juice, smoked paprika, and salt until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to serve. Preheat oven to 375°F. Slice the loaf in half lengthwise and spread generously with garlic butter.
Top with half the mozzarella, hot honey chicken, remaining mozzarella, and Parmesan.
Bake for 10–15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the edges are golden. Broil for 1–2 minutes if desired, watching closely.
Remove from the oven and drizzle generously with the remaining hot honey. Garnish with fresh parsley and Parmesan.
Slice and serve warm with the hot honey garlic aioli for dipping.
#recipe #garlicbread #hothoneychicken
Video by iramsfoodstory

dishes.title: Honey Garlic Pork Belly
dishes.subtitle: From Ryan Miller
steps: Mix the honey, soy sauce, mirin, garlic, chili flakes, and water until combined
Set the sauce aside
Cut the pork belly into chunks
Add the pork belly to a pan with no oil
Fry until golden and a majority of the fat is rendered
Drain the fat
Add the sauce to the same pan
Cook until bubbly
Finish with the corn starch slurry to thicken

dishes.title: Chikkar Chole
dishes.subtitle: From Ralston D'Souza
steps: Soak the dried chickpeas overnight, then drain and rinse well.
Add the soaked chickpeas, potato, bay leaf, salt and water to a pressure cooker.
Pressure cook until tender, then remove from heat.
Blend the cooked potato, cooked chickpeas, yogurt and cooker water until smooth and set aside.
Heat the mustard oil in a pan on medium heat.
Add the onions, ginger and green chillies and cook until the onions turn golden brown.
Add the turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and chana masala.
Mix well.
Pour in the yogurt and potato mixture and cook for a short time.
Add the cooked chickpeas along with some of the cooking liquid.
Add the brown sugar and salt.
Mix well and simmer until the gravy becomes thick and slightly mushy.
Heat the ghee for the tadka.
Add the slit green chillies, ginger juliennes, kasuri methi and hing and let sizzle.
Pour the tadka over the chole.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

dishes.title: Egg Ghee Roast
dishes.subtitle: From Ralston D'Souza
steps: Dry roast the spices until fragrant.
Transfer the spices to a blender.
Grind into a fine powder.
Set the powder aside.
Blend the chillies, garlic, cashews, tamarind paste and water into a smooth paste.
Set the paste aside.
Heat the oil.
Scramble the eggs with salt.
Set the scrambled eggs aside.
Heat the ghee.
Add cumin seeds, onion, salt and curry leaves.
Saute until the onions turn golden brown.
Add the chilli cashew paste and roasted spice powder.
Pour in water.
Mix well.
Cover and cook until the masala thickens and oil begins to separate.
Add the scrambled eggs.
Mix until well coated in the masala.
Serve.

dishes.title: Lemon Pepper Chicken
dishes.subtitle: From Ralston D'Souza
steps: Make a few shallow slits in the chicken thighs.
Coat the chicken thighs well in a bowl with ginger garlic paste, salt, chillie flakes, pepper, oregano, sugar, lime juice and ghee.
Marinate for 30 minutes or overnight.
Fry the chicken in a pan on medium heat for 8 minutes each side.
Garnish with fresh coriander, lime juice and chaat masala.
Mix the Greek yogurt, garlic, chopped coriander, lime juice, salt and black pepper until smooth.
Serve alongside the chicken.

dishes.title: Spicy Tomato Masala Rice
dishes.subtitle: From Bharat Wadhwa
steps: Boil the water with salt, green cardamoms, cloves, bay leaf, green chillies, coriander stems and garam masala.
Add the rice, soya chunks, corns, peas and carrot and boil until cooked, then drain.
Heat the oil with butter and crackle the cumin seeds.
Add the tomatoes, onion, garlic cloves, green chillies, salt and water and cook to a masala.
Add the turmeric powder, red chilli powder, Kashmiri red chilli powder and garam masala and mix well.
Mix the boiled rice with the masala, garnish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

dishes.title: Restaurant Style Soya Masala
dishes.subtitle: From Ralston D'Souza
steps: Boil the soya chunks in water with salt and turmeric for 5 minutes.
Drain the water out.
Heat oil and butter in a pan on medium heat and add the boiled and drained soya chunks and cubed potato.
Saute for about 5 minutes till lightly golden brown, then set aside.
Heat oil and butter in the same pan and add the onion.
Saute till the onion turns nice and golden brown.
Add ginger garlic paste, slit green chilli and tomato.
Cook till the tomato turns nice and mushy.
Add Kashmiri red chilli powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder and pepper powder.
Add salt, cashew paste and yogurt.
Mix well, then add the cooked soya chunks and coat them nicely with the masala.
Add water and mix well.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Uncover the pan.
Add garam masala, Kasuri methi, butter and fresh coriander.
Give it one final mix.
Serve hot.

dishes.title: Palak Paneer
dishes.subtitle: From Richa Gupta
steps: Wash the palak thoroughly under running water and drain.
Heat ghee in a pan and add chopped garlic, green chilli and sliced onion.
Add the washed palak and fresh coriander to the pan.
Cover and cook until wilted, then transfer to a blender jar and blend to a smooth vibrant green puree.
Heat ghee in the same pan and temper bayleaf, cardamom pods and cloves.
Add finely chopped ginger, chopped tomato, jeera powder, coriander powder and garam masala and cook until soft and jammy.
Add the blended palak puree, water, salt, kasuri methi and cream and simmer.
Heat oil in a separate pan and brown the whole paneer block on all sides.
Cut the browned paneer into cubes.
Heat ghee for tadka and sizzle smashed garlic, dried red chillies, jeera and red chilli powder and pour over the curry.
Add the paneer cubes to the gravy, drizzle with cream and serve.

dishes.title: Chinese Tomato Eggs
dishes.subtitle: From Kylie Sakaida
steps: Whisk together the eggs, salt and white pepper.
Add oil to a pan.
Add the eggs to the pan.
Cook until still a little runny.
Remove the eggs before fully cooked.
Add oil and ginger to the pan.
Cook the tomatoes for a few minutes on medium heat.
Sprinkle with salt.
Add oyster sauce, ketchup and water.
Cook for a few minutes until the tomatoes soften.
Add the eggs back in.
Gently stir everything together until the eggs are fully cooked.
Serve with white rice.
Top with green onions.
